notes.title: April 6th Major Update
notes.content:
Added new hero Kun Kun and breakthrough hero Great Sage.

Kun Kun: Can throw a basketball that will explode upon a second glance, causing terrifying damage.
Great Sage, the Limit Breaker: Can charge up to enlarge and elongate his golden cudgel, causing greater area damage.

Added new items:
Plum Juice: After eating a banana, you can throw the banana peel, causing area damage.
My Fruit Stand: Gain extra coins when picking up bananas.
Headless Lady Gun: Prioritizes attacking enemy snipers and advanced summon units of self-propelled artillery.

Added death sound effects for killing enemies.
Increased score bonus for killing enemies.
Updated gun sound volume adjustment.
Reduced the speed of Mutant Crabs generating Radioactive Fish to avoid an overabundance of fish with nowhere to hide.
Enhanced the guiding speed of the experimental mech's laser.
Enhanced the flight speed of the demon's sword energy.
Significantly increased the damage of the heavy sniper rifle.
Greatly strengthened the explosion range and damage of the Roc Bomb.
Increased banana drop rate.
Golden weapons can now provide two weapon synergy levels.
Advanced weapons will increase the damage of active skills.
There is a chance for the "I Want to Reassemble the Army" to refresh advanced summons in low rounds.

notes.title: February 24th Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where snipers would get stuck on aircraft carriers.
Resolved an issue with hand grenades exploding on aircraft carriers.
Fixed a bug where the ESC key could not be used to exit the ESC menu.
Adjusted the maximum enhancement range of spell animation effects to 2.5 times to prevent obstruction of vision due to excessively large spell ranges in later stages. Damage effects remain unchanged.

notes.title: February 17th Update
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the character's completion difficulty level was not recorded after quitting and restarting mid-game.
Increased the trigger range of the bouncing grenade.
Improved the rate of fire and range of the speed controller.
Enhanced the damage and range of Russian semi-automatic rifles of purple rarity and above.
Reduced the aiming time of sniper rifles and increased their range.
Reduced the visual effects of plants and characters competing for air and water, alleviating optimization pressure.
Strengthened the backflip monkey, which now respawns directly among enemies after performing a backflip.

notes.title: "Black Gun God Wukong" is set to be released on February 5th
notes.content:
The official version of "Black Gunner Wukong" has undergone two months of development, with the main body of the game now essentially complete. It is set to be released on February 5th.

Key features include:

3 new maps: Aircraft Carrier Fleet, Biochemical Laboratory, and Chaos in the White House.
4 new enemies: Missile Truck, Fixed-wing Fighter, Biochemical Monster, and Mecha.
Addition of 6 heroes, bringing the total number of heroes to 12: 2 versions of Nezha, 2 female demons, Chuan Jianguo, and Sun Wukong.
Three new weapons: Quick Slow Machine (an automatic pistol), Minotaur Submachine Gun, and an Automatic Sniper Rifle.
6 new magical treasures:
Active Treasures: Homeland Monkey (fires at enemies using fiery eyes), Missile Strike, Yin-Yang Dual Gas Bottle.
Passive Treasures: Three Hairs, Unyielding, Extra Peach.
Expansion of styles to 13 types!
Various new items, including a prison that throws basketballs from a helicopter, a plant that fights for air with enemies, a water person who moves in waves high in the sky, and a truck loaded with gold.
Introduction of a 20-round mode and an Endless mode.
Level cap increased to level 8.
Starting weapon combinations increased to 20.
Addition of difficulty level 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44141782/7c5392118e8f7744c0b246e6edb36fb8e4539fda.png[/img]

Details Fixes:

Tyrannosaurus Rex and Mammoth forms can now consume bananas.
Clarified the bonuses that items and skills receive.
White weapons will no longer be refreshed in the later stages.
Added an option for players to exit the game and receive mid-game gold settlements.
Adjusted the orientation of the arms, making it easier to see the models of the six guns.
Wukong has received a new batch of witty lines.

notes.title: October 26th Update
notes.content:
Store Updates:

More of your owned firearm types will refresh in the store.
Faction Modifications:

Steadfast as Taishan has been modified to allow sitting in chairs, and using this faction will now have your character appear seated in a chair.
Monkey King's Rise has been enhanced to provide an additional 50 peaches per turn.
Faction Changes:

Enlightenment now has a -20% reduction in spell cooldowns and a chance to gain advanced spells early.

notes.title: October 21st Major Update.
notes.content:
Monkey King's Rise: Choosing this faction increases gold income by 50%.
Steadfast as Taishan: Lose the ability to fly and jump but gain +200 defense, +30 evasion, +100 life regeneration, and +500 HP with a 30% movement speed reduction.
Silver Horn King: Doubles the rate of magical item recovery.
Enlightenment: Reduces firearm damage by 80% and increases spell damage by 200%.
Phantom Shadows: Decreases defense by 450, increases movement speed by 100%, adds 40% evasion, raises evasion cap to 85%, and flying no longer consumes mana.
Myriad Heavenly Soldiers: Increases the duration of summoned entities by 100%.
Perfectionist: Doubles the combined effects of similar weapon types.
New Items:

Sun Family's Dominance: Increases the duration of summoned entities by 20%.
Grandmaster's Celestial Art: Reduces spell cooldowns by 10%.
Ancient Blade: Throws the Ancient Blade to damage enemies.
Tiger Hide Armor: Grants +200 HP and +5% evasion.
Skill Enhancements:

Enhanced the damage and range of Thunderstruck Whip, Frosty Skies, and Bouncy Grenades.
Reduced the cooldown of Celestial Magic.
Enhanced the effects of Machine Guns and Gatling Gun Strafing.

notes.title: October 7th New Item Update.
notes.content:
Cyber Wukong's active skill now provides an additional healing effect. This means that when Cyber Wukong uses his active skill, he will recover a certain amount of health.

Added enemy units, snipers. These may be a new type of enemy who can attack your heroes from a distance.

Increased prompts for attacking enemy artillery and snipers. This may be to help players better deal with these threats.

Added beginner rewards. When new players successfully complete 5 rounds, 10 rounds, and 15 rounds for the first time, they can receive additional rewards. This is designed to encourage new players to participate in the game.

Added a custom initial item function. This means that players can choose some initial items at the beginning of the game, which may affect their hero or game strategy.

Added new items:

Monkey Cola: +30 magic restoration.
Wind-Breaking Pill: +8% movement speed and +8% evasion.
Banana Fan: Summons a storm attack with the Banana Fan, with a maximum of 3 storms.
Big Stomach Monkey: Increases the probability of enemies dropping food, stackable up to 3 times.
Artillery Counter: Calls for artillery support, prioritizing the attack on self-propelled artillery and snipers, stackable up to 3 times.

notes.title: Added a new hero, Cyber Wukong
notes.content:
Starting to record the number of completed rounds and the highest difficulty level completed.
Added a new hero, Cyber Wukong, who can release electric pulse attacks on nearby enemies. Available after surviving for 15 rounds or more.
Added more language support.
The right-click has been unlocked, and the Flying Nimbus now only requires a single click to keep flying continuously.
The store page now includes various tooltips.
Now, self-propelled artillery will also refresh during the last few rounds of difficulty 0.
Bananas can be consumed while in high altitudes.
